Endless Crown

Privacy policy.

Effective date: June 5, 2026

Endless Crown does not collect, transmit, sell, or share personal data.

Data Collection

Endless Crown does not collect data from the app.


The app saves your settings and usage history on your Apple Watch. This includes your chosen click or vibration pattern, ambient mode setting, current number, and effect counts. It uses Apple’s built-in device storage and shares the information needed to show your Watch app’s information on its watch-face shortcut.

Tracking

Endless Crown does not track you across apps or websites owned by other companies.

Accounts, Ads, and Analytics

Endless Crown does not require an account and does not include ads or third-party usage tracking. It does not send app data to a server.

Contact

For support or privacy questions, email EndlessCrown@jenny.media.

For public bug reports or feature requests, you can also open an issue on GitHub.
